title: Plane / Cross / Crossing Contract
purpose: Canonical machine-readable distinction between Plane, Axis, O/Cross-point, Cross-sign, Door and crossing events.

plane.canonical_3d: Sigma: z=0 perpendicular to the source↔manifestation Axis
plane.operation: select current world-facing frame and expose lateral relations

axis.operation: orders source↔manifestation direction and carries vertical/developmental relation

cross_point.operation: locate the simultaneous legibility of vertical orientation and active frame

cross_sign.equation: CrossSign = Axis ∪ L, L⊂Plane and O∈L
cross_sign.operation: show vertical source/manifestation relation together with one chosen lateral relation

door.operation: govern admissible state/context passage inside the overlap
door.plane_relation: Plane sections Door at the widest midpoint aperture

crossing_event.operation: record Gamma(t*) intersecting Plane and distinguish weak section crossing from strong Door transition; later lifecycle stages determine incorporation and recurrence.

recurrence_contract.ring: same recurrence without meaningful net change
recurrence_contract.spiral: recurrence with meaningful change; sign/quality of change must be specified separately
recurrence_contract.rule: Elapsed time alone does not convert Ring into Spiral.

world_plane_contract.meaning: current operative section of embodied/social/material relations

laws: Plane sections; it does not own.
Axis orients; it does not contain.
O locates the intersection; it does not exhaust Plane or Door.
Door transitions; Plane can be crossed without every crossing being a strong Door.
Cross-sign is a visual projection; cross-point is a geometric relation.
Every Plane is frame-relative: scale/time/representation should be explicit.
Repeated Plane crossings are evidence for recurrence only after comparable variables are declared.
The lower field is not the Plane; the Plane is a world-facing section through the larger two-field relation.
